name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 15 – Am 54
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 15a. Welcomes the fact that several Member States support the Egyptian plan for the reconstruction of Gaza; urges the Commission to assist in the plan’s implementation; reiterates that a negotiated two-state solution under which Palestinians and Israelis can live in peaceful coexistence depends on a reconstructed and viable Palestinian society; acknowledges that the world community is paramount in the reconstruction of Gaza; reiterates that European security is entirely interconnected with respect for international law and peaceful solutions to conflicts in our immediate surroundings;
